rules: Logo only on white or the light tint, never on the dark green or on photos; never recolor or stretch it
Accent lime is a fill (bars, blocks), never text on white; use link green for green text
Headlines in uppercase condensed display font; body in the sans; no emoji, no exclamation points
Corners square on bands and blocks, 3px on buttons, 6px on cards
Photos get a dark-green overlay behind white text; no gradients, no stock illustrations
Name the submarket (St. Petersburg, Pinellas County) rather than a generic Florida market
